For every tournament played, points are awarded based on the player's Return Percentage (%) in that tournament. Higher return percentages will result in higher leaderboard points.
Players also earn points based on their final rank/position in each tournament. Better finishing positions receive higher points.
The leaderboard will run on a monthly basis.
At the end of each month, rewards will be distributed automatically based on the leaderbaord rank.
Rewards will be credited directly to the player's withdrawable balance / wallet.
Example: A player with a 12.5% return earns 125 points.
